$schema_note: Manifest of external test artefacts. See docs/test-roms.md for the audit record.
Nothing listed here is committed to this repository. docs/scope.md section 7 keeps
test ROMs out of the tree, and ADR 0008 (layout) rule 6 keeps fetched artefacts out
of every target's source directory. They are fetched into roms/, which is gitignored.
Every license field was read from the named source on the named date, not recalled.
A suite with wired=false is recorded but has no acquisition path yet, deliberately.

suites.title: Blargg cpu_instrs, individual ROMs
suites.validates: Instruction behaviour and flags. The primary CPU oracle after the SM83 suite, and the only ROMs gameboy-doctor supports.
suites.milestone: CPU, then interrupt controller and timer
notes: Each individual ROM is 32,768 bytes: no MBC. They can therefore run before any
mapper exists. The combined cpu_instrs.gb is 65,536 bytes and needs MBC1, which
is why it is not listed here.
02-interrupts requires a working timer, so the full set passes at the milestone
that implements the interrupt controller and timer, not at the CPU milestone.

license.evidence: No LICENSE file exists in the repository. readme.txt records only the original and current hosting URLs. cpu_instrs/readme.txt documents the test format and ends with the author's signature; it contains no copyright notice, no permission grant, and no statement of terms.
license.redistribution: NOT PERMITTED BY ANY WRITTEN GRANT. Default copyright applies. This project fetches these ROMs at test time, never redistributes them, and never includes them in a release artefact.

origin.availability_note: This is a third-party mirror whose last commit is from 2015. Pinning the commit protects integrity, not availability. If it disappears, the secondary origin is the fallback and the pin must be re-established.

suites.title: SingleStepTests SM83 per-opcode tests
suites.validates: Per-opcode initial state, final state, and the ordered list of bus transactions with their cycle positions. ADR 0002 (timing model) names it the oracle that validates tick placement directly.
notes: 500 files, roughly 160 MB uncompressed: 244 base opcodes and 256 CB-prefixed.
Fetching the whole set on every CI run is expensive, so the fetcher supports
fetching a subset. How much CI fetches is decided by the milestone that consumes
it, with measurement, rather than guessed here.
These are JSON, not ROMs. They need no cartridge and no mapper.

license.evidence: LICENSE file present, full MIT text read.
license.redistribution: Permitted with attribution. This project still does not commit them, because the no-vendoring rule is uniform and needs no per-suite reasoning.

suites.title: dmg-acid2
suites.validates: PPU rendering correctness: sprite priority, the window line counter, the 10-sprite limit, palette handling. A wrong result is a visibly deformed face rather than an opaque failure.
notes: 32,768 bytes: no MBC, so it runs before any mapper exists.
Recorded with a verified hash so wiring it later is a one-line change.

license.evidence: LICENSE file present, full MIT text read.

suites.title: Mooneye Test Suite
suites.validates: Precise timing, MBC behaviour, PPU edge cases, and the power-on state comparison ADR 0002 names as the adjudicator of the tick/access ordering.
notes: Source only. No releases and no prebuilt ROMs: building it requires RGBDS.
Not wired now because putting an assembler toolchain into CI before anything
consumes its output is the kind of seam docs/scope.md and the YAGNI rule exclude.
Wired at the milestone that first needs it, together with a pinned RGBDS version.

license.evidence: LICENSE file present, full MIT text read.

suites.title: Mealybug Tearoom Tests
suites.milestone: the optional FIFO renderer milestone, if it happens
notes: Out of scope for the scanline renderer by construction: ADR 0002's accuracy
ceiling means behaviour requiring interleaving inside an M-cycle is not
representable. Recorded so that its absence is a decision rather than an
oversight.
